name: Viewarr
description: House settings for Viewarr, the Android TV app for Dispatcharr: the outside addresses of your servers, read by every Viewarr when it starts.
author: petebutty

fields.label: What this is
fields.help_text: Viewarr reads these settings each time it starts, on every TV signed in to this Dispatcharr. Change an address here (or in Viewarr: Settings → Profiles → Away addresses) and every TV follows. Anyone signed in to Dispatcharr can read plugin settings, so only addresses belong here: never passwords, keys or addon links.

fields.label: Outside addresses
fields.help_text: One per line: home address = outside address. For example: http://192.168.1.50:9191 = https://tv.example.com. A TV that can't reach the home address uses the outside one.

actions.label: Check outside addresses
actions.description: Asks each outside address from this server and says which answer.
